roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/onboarding/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo steps and options, add or drop steps, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Guided setup after sign-in: Welcome, Workspace (validation error, submitting), Connect or choose with the SetupGuide, Done. Not sign-in and not empty-first-run.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per step: Get started, Continue, or Go to dashboard
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens

Progress is a kit ProgressSteps: vertical in the Stage side column (SideNav blocks), or horizontal in a header landmark (AppHeader); the step content is in <main>, labelled with the step number and name
Back is a ghost Button; Skip for now is ghost; Save and exit stays reachable on every step before Done
Wrap every labeled input in Field; a missing workspace name shows the Field error, sets the Input's error, and moves focus to it
While the workspace is being created the fields, Back and the primary are disabled and a kit Spinner with a visible label ("Creating workspace…") says what is happening
Motion only through kit components: BlurCrossfade on the step heading (it honours reduced motion); do not wrap the form or the SetupGuide in it

Page layout uses kit layout classes (layout-shell, layout-shell--inset, layout-app, layout-content, layout-container-sm, layout-split) and grid / layout tokens; no hard-coded columns, gutters, max-widths or breakpoints
defaults: Four steps: Welcome, Workspace, Connect, Done; the Connect step is the kit SetupGuide, so what's left there carries over to the dashboard

layout="stage" (default, Paper's second row and the Nistha site's look): a side column on the canvas with the brand, SET UP · 4 STEPS and vertical ProgressSteps, Save and exit at its foot, and the step on an inset card panel (layout-shell--inset) with Step N of 4 at the top; below --grid-breakpoint-md, and with layout="header", a reduced AppHeader with horizontal ProgressSteps and Save and exit. No dense app nav in either
The step column is layout-container-sm, centred on the page; the footer bar holds Back (start) and the primary (end), centred on Done
Enter submits the step (⏎ on Continue); onCreateWorkspace may return a promise to hold the submitting state
Done is a kit Empty with a check, Workspace created and N tasks left Badges, and Go to dashboard
snippet: <OnboardingPattern layout="stage" step={step} onStepChange={setStep} onCreateWorkspace={createWorkspace} onSaveAndExit={saveAndExit} onFinish={goToDashboard} />
